faculty.name: Dolores Albarracín
faculty.summary: Studies attitudes, persuasion, and behavioral change, focusing on how beliefs influence actions and how to correct misinformation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究态度、说服和行为改变，关注信念如何影响行为以及如何纠正错误信息。

faculty.name: Coren Apicella
faculty.summary: Studies decision processes and social behaviors in humans, focusing on cooperation and moral perceptions across cultures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类决策过程和社会行为，重点关注跨文化的合作和道德感知。

faculty.name: Michael Arcaro
faculty.summary: Studies how the environment shapes neural development and supports visual perception across mammalian species using neuroimaging, visual psychophysics, and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境如何塑造哺乳动物神经系统的发育并支持视觉感知，使用神经成像、视觉心理物理学和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Sudeep Bhatia
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive basis of human judgment and decision making using mathematical and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类判断和决策的认知基础，使用数学和计算模型。

faculty.name: Tyler Bonnen
faculty.summary: Studies computational models of perception and memory, integrating methods from neuroscience, psychology, and computer science.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉和记忆的计算模型，结合神经科学、心理学和计算机科学的方法。

faculty.name: David Brainard
faculty.summary: Studies human vision, investigating how the visual system estimates object properties from light signals, using psychophysical experiments and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类视觉，探讨视觉系统如何从光线信号中估计物体属性，使用心理物理学实验和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Johannes Burge
faculty.summary: Studies how humans estimate depth from natural images, using computational models and behavioral studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何从自然图像中估计深度，使用计算模型和行为研究。

faculty.name: Delphine Dahan
faculty.summary: Studies how listeners interpret spoken language, focusing on the time course of interpretation and the role of context in speech comprehension.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听者如何解释口头语言，重点关注解释的时间进程以及上下文在言语理解中的作用。

faculty.name: Angela Duckworth
faculty.summary: Studies how individuals differ in their perseverance and self-control, focusing on the development of grit.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体在毅力和自我控制方面的差异，重点关注坚毅的发展。

faculty.name: Russell Epstein
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying visual scene perception, object recognition, and spatial navigation in humans using fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类视觉场景感知、物体识别和空间导航的神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术。

faculty.name: Martha Farah
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience, focusing on brain systems for behavior and perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知神经科学，关注行为和感知的脑系统。

faculty.name: Loretta Flanagan-Cato
faculty.summary: Develops community-engaged neuroscience courses to improve mood and reduce intergroup anxiety.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发社区参与神经科学课程以改善情绪并减少群体焦虑。

faculty.name: Steven Fluharty
faculty.summary: Studies the regulation of neuropeptide receptor gene expression and signal transduction in neurons and animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经肽受体基因表达和信号转导的调节及其在神经元和动物中的作用。

faculty.name: Geoffrey Goodwin
faculty.summary: Studies social cognition and moral psychology, exploring how people judge and reason about moral actions and beliefs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知和道德心理学，探讨人们如何判断和推理关于道德行为和信念的问题。

faculty.name: Jay Gottfried
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of human smell, focusing on odor codes, circuits, and percepts using fMRI and intracranial EEG.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类嗅觉的神经生物学，重点在于气味代码、电路和感知，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和颅内脑电图（intracranial EEG）。

faculty.name: Sara Jaffee
faculty.summary: Studies the development of antisocial behavior in children, focusing on gene-environment interactions and longitudinal effects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童反社会行为的发展，重点关注基因-环境交互作用和纵向效应。

faculty.name: Adrianna Jenkins
faculty.summary: Studies social cognition and its relationship to decision-making, focusing on the prefrontal cortex and uncertainty in social contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知及其与决策的关系，重点关注前额叶皮层和社交不确定性机制。

faculty.name: Joseph Kable
faculty.summary: Studies how people make decisions, using fMRI and methods from social and cognitive neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何做出决策，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和社会认知神经科学的方法。

faculty.name: Allyson Mackey
faculty.summary: Studies brain plasticity and its impact on learning and academic outcomes, using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑可塑性及其对学习和学术成果的影响，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Barbara Mellers
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making and forecasting accuracy, using psychological strategies to improve policy-relevant predictions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策和预测准确性，通过心理策略提高政策相关预测的质量。

faculty.name: Daniel Moriarity
faculty.summary: Studies the dynamic interplay between stress, immunology, and affective psychopathology, refining clinical phenotypes and integrating biological mechanisms into psychosocial frameworks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力、免疫学与情感精神病理之间的动态相互作用，细化临床表型并整合生物机制到心理社会框架中。

faculty.name: Michael L. Platt
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making and social interaction, applying insights from brain science to business and sports.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策和社交互动，将脑科学的见解应用于商业和体育。

faculty.name: Nicole Rust
faculty.summary: Studies how memory and mood are processed in the brain, combining human behavior, neural activity measurements, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和情绪在大脑中的处理过程，结合人类行为、神经活动测量和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Nacho Sanguinetti
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of adaptive cognitive processes in wild rodents, focusing on play behavior and scatter-hoarding.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究野生啮齿动物的适应性认知过程的神经基础，重点关注玩耍行为和散播储藏行为。

faculty.name: Anna Schapiro
faculty.summary: Studies how memories of regularities in the environment are formed and consolidated, using neural network modeling and empirical methods like fMRI and EEG.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境中的规律性记忆是如何形成和巩固的，使用神经网络建模和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）等实证方法。

faculty.name: Martin Seligman
faculty.summary: Studies positive psychology, optimism, learned helplessness, and well-being, using big data and coaching.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究积极心理学、乐观主义、习得无助感和幸福感，使用大数据和辅导方法。

faculty.name: Alan Stocker
faculty.summary: Studies how visual perception is shaped by beliefs and expectations, using theory and experiments to understand the underlying computations and neural processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知如何受到信念和预期的影响，通过理论和实验来理解背后的计算和神经过程。

faculty.name: Daniel Swingley
faculty.summary: Studies how infants and young children learn and recognize words, using perceptual experiments and statistical analyses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何学习和识别单词，使用知觉实验和统计分析方法。

faculty.name: Philip Tetlock
faculty.summary: Studies how experts think about possible pasts and probable futures, and how accountability pressures affect judgment and choice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究专家如何思考可能的历史和可能的未来，以及问责制压力如何影响判断和选择。

faculty.name: Sharon Thompson-Schill
faculty.summary: Studies the biological bases of human cognitive systems, focusing on the frontal lobe's role in memory and language, using fMRI and TMS.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类认知系统的生物基础，特别是前额叶在记忆和语言中的作用，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和经颅磁刺激（TMS）。

faculty.name: John Trueswell
faculty.summary: Studies how children and adults learn words and grammar, using eye-tracking to observe real-time language comprehension.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何学习词汇和语法，使用眼动追踪观察实时语言理解。

faculty.name: Rebecca Waller
faculty.summary: Studies socioemotional development and the environmental factors influencing antisocial behavior in children, using fMRI and genetic models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童社会情感发展及其反社会行为的环境因素，使用功能性磁共振成像和遗传模型。

faculty.name: Axon Guidance
faculty.summary: Studies axon guidance, a cellular and molecular process in neural development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究轴突导向，神经发育中的细胞和分子过程。

faculty.name: Imaging Approaches
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience using imaging approaches to understand decision-making processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用成像方法研究认知神经科学，以理解决策过程。

faculty.name: Neuron-Glia Interactions
faculty.summary: Studies neuron-glia interactions using computational and molecular methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经-胶质细胞相互作用，使用计算和分子方法。

faculty.name: Joshua I. Gold
faculty.summary: Studies how inference and learning shape decision-making processes in the brain, using behavioral, electrophysiological, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究推理和学习如何塑造大脑中的决策过程，使用行为学、电生理学和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Joseph W Kable
faculty.summary: Studies how people make decisions, tracing psychological and neural mechanisms using fMRI and interdisciplinary methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类决策的心理和神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和跨学科方法。

faculty.name: Michael J. Kahana
faculty.summary: Studies human episodic memory using behavioral and electrophysiological methods, and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类事件记忆，使用行为和电生理方法以及计算模型。

faculty.name: Erica Korb
faculty.summary: Studies how chromatin modifications regulate learning and memory, focusing on histone variants and their role in neurodevelopmental disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究染色质修饰如何调节学习和记忆，重点关注组蛋白变体及其在神经发育障碍中的作用。

faculty.name: Konrad P Kording
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between neural structure and function, using causal inference and machine learning to reverse-engineer nervous systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经结构与功能之间的关系，使用因果推断和机器学习方法反向工程神经系统。

faculty.name: Lauren Kreeger
faculty.summary: Studies the auditory system and neural circuits involved in hearing, using electrophysiology and anatomical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉系统和参与听觉的神经回路，使用电生理学和解剖学方法。

faculty.name: Manzar Ashtari
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: Nicholas L. Balderston
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of clinical anxiety using psychophysiology, neuroimaging, and neuromodulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究临床焦虑的机制，使用生理心理学、神经成像和神经调节方法。

faculty.name: MD Ran Barzilay
faculty.summary: Studies the development of brain and behavior in stressed children and adolescents, focusing on risk and resilience factors leading to suicidal behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力下儿童和青少年的大脑和行为发展，重点关注导致自杀行为的风险和韧性因素。

faculty.name: MD Mathias Basner
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of sleep and circadian rhythms on cognitive performance and mental health, using experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠和昼夜节律对认知表现和心理健康的影响，使用实验方法。

faculty.name: Danielle S. Bassett
faculty.summary: Studies biological, physical, and social systems using network science and complex systems theory, focusing on brain networks and predicting learning and disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生物、物理和社会系统，使用网络科学和复杂系统理论，特别是在大脑网络、学习预测和疾病诊断方面。

faculty.name: Michael Stephen Beauchamp
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of multisensory integration, particularly the McGurk effect, using electrophysiological recording and deep neural network models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多感官整合的神经基础，特别是麦格尔效应，使用电生理记录和深度神经网络模型。

faculty.name: Timothy A. Machado
faculty.summary: Studies how motor command pathways interact to generate specific movements using multiregion neural recording techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动指令路径如何相互作用以生成特定动作，使用多区域神经记录技术。

faculty.name: J Nicholas Betley
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Allyson P Mackey
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Seema Bhatnagar
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits impacted by chronic stress and how they contribute to affective and anxiety disorders, using rats and advanced neuroscience techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究慢性应激对神经回路的影响及其如何导致情感和焦虑障碍，使用大鼠和先进的神经科学技术。

faculty.name: Sandra Maday
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular mechanisms of learning and memory in the brain.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中学习和记忆的细胞机制。

faculty.name: Julie A. Blendy
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular basis of addiction and depression using mouse models and behavioral genetics, focusing on CREB and CREM transcription factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾和抑郁的分子基础，使用小鼠模型和行为遗传学，重点关注CREB和CREM转录因子。

faculty.name: Lauren M Massimo
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory in humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类学习和记忆的神经机制。

faculty.name: Corey T McMillan
faculty.summary: Studies neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and ALS, using brain imaging and genetic analyses to identify biomarkers for diagnosis and treatment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病和ALS等神经退行性疾病，使用脑成像和基因分析来识别诊断和治疗的生物标志物。

faculty.name: Roberto Bonasio
faculty.summary: Studies molecular mechanisms of epigenetic memory, focusing on noncoding RNAs and chromatin biochemistry.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究表观遗传记忆的分子机制，重点关注非编码RNA和染色质生物化学。

faculty.name: David H Brainard
faculty.summary: Studies how the visual system estimates object properties from light signals, using psychophysical experiments and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉系统如何从光线信号中估计物体属性，使用心理物理学实验和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Arghya Mukherjee
faculty.summary: Studies how brain circuits in the prefrontal cortex support cognitive functions like memory and reasoning, using behavioral physiology and optogenetic techniques in rodents and treeshrews.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层如何支持记忆和推理等认知功能，使用行为生理学和光遗传学技术在啮齿动物和松鼠猴中进行研究。

faculty.name: Gideon Nave
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making processes and their neural basis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程及其神经基础。

faculty.name: Natali L Chanaday
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons communicate at the single synapse level, focusing on neurotransmission and endocytosis using electrophysiology and live imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元在单个突触水平上的通讯机制，重点研究神经递质释放和内吞作用，使用电生理学和活体成像技术。

faculty.name: M.D. Anjan Chatterjee
faculty.summary: Studies how spatial attention and representation work in the brain, using behavioral studies and neuroimaging in patients and normal subjects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究空间注意力和表征的认知神经科学，使用患者和正常受试者的行为研究和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Desmond J. Oathes
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological signatures of anxiety and depression using fMRI and TMS, focusing on affective disorders and PTSD.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑和抑郁的神经生物学特征，使用功能性磁共振成像和经颅磁刺激，重点关注情感障碍和PTSD。

faculty.name: Shinjae Chung
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits controlling sleep and their interconnections with emotional states, using techniques like optogenetics and in vivo physiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究调控睡眠的神经回路及其与情绪状态的相互作用，使用光遗传学和体内生理学等技术。

faculty.name: MD Joseph Cichon
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and circuit mechanisms of anesthetics, rapid-acting antidepressants, and psychedelics using animal models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究麻醉剂、快速起效抗抑郁药和致幻剂的细胞和回路机制，使用动物模型进行研究。

faculty.name: Rebecca L. Pearl
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of cognitive control and decision-making processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制和决策过程的神经基础。

faculty.name: Yale E. Cohen
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain combines sensory, motor, and cognitive cues to form internal models of the external world, focusing on auditory information in the cortex.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何结合感觉、运动和认知线索形成对外部世界的内部模型，重点在于听觉信息在皮层中的处理。

faculty.name: Jennifer E. Phillips-Cremins
faculty.summary: Studies the structure and function of chromatin in neurons, using genomics and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元中的染色质结构与功能，使用基因组学和计算方法。

faculty.name: Gregory Corder
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of pain perception and opioid dependence, using in vivo calcium imaging and optogenetics in rodent models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究疼痛感知和阿片类依赖的神经基础，使用体内钙成像和光遗传学在啮齿动物模型中进行.

faculty.name: Robert Christopher Pierce
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Michael Louis Platt
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making processes, using techniques like single neuron recordings and brain imaging to understand how the brain handles complex and ambiguous decisions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程，使用单个神经元记录和脑成像等技术来理解大脑如何处理复杂和模棱两可的决策。

faculty.name: M.D. Alexander Proekt
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of working memory and consciousness using computational and systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和意识的神经机制，采用计算和系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: John A. Dani
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying addiction and their similarities to learning processes, using behavioral tasks and pharmacological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾的神经机制及其与学习过程的相似性，使用行为任务和药理学方法。

faculty.name: Mariella De Biasi
faculty.summary: Studies drug addiction and its mechanisms using electrophysiology and behavioral testing in preclinical genetic models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾及其机制，使用电生理学和行为测试在预临床遗传模型中。

faculty.name: Timothy P. Roberts
faculty.summary: Studies brain imaging techniques, focusing on MRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑成像技术，重点是MRI。

faculty.name: Yanxiang Deng
faculty.summary: Studies spatial profiling of genomic and epigenomic features in tissues using advanced sequencing and omics techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究组织中基因组和表观基因组特征的空间分布，使用先进的测序和组学技术。

faculty.name: Nicole C Rust
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of visual memory in humans and animals, combining behavioral experiments, neural activity measurements, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类和动物的视觉记忆的神经基础，结合行为实验、神经活动测量和计算建模。

faculty.name: John A. Detre
faculty.summary: Studies brain physiology and pathophysiology of functional activation using magnetic resonance techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究功能性激活的脑生理和病理生理学，使用磁共振技术。

faculty.name: David F. Dinges
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of sleep and circadian rhythms on cognitive performance and neurobehavioral functions in humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠和昼夜节律对人类认知表现和神经行为功能的影响。

faculty.name: Heath Donmar Schmidt
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用计算模型和神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Marc F. Schmidt
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of vocal production, perception and learning in songbirds, using chronic recording and behavioral analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鸣禽的发声、感知和学习的神经机制，使用慢性记录和行为分析方法。

faculty.name: MD Jacob Dubroff
faculty.summary: Studies neuroreceptor PET imaging and molecular imaging of neurological and psychiatric diseases, focusing on addiction and brain plasticity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经受体PET成像和神经精神疾病分子成像，重点关注成瘾和大脑可塑性。

faculty.name: Benjamin Scholl
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and attention, using psychophysical methods and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，使用心理物理学方法和计算模型。

faculty.name: Amita Sehgal
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular networks driving rhythmic behaviors, particularly sleep, using fruit flies, mice, and human cells.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究驱动节律行为（尤其是睡眠）的分子和细胞网络，使用果蝇、小鼠和人类细胞进行研究。

faculty.name: J. Christopher Edgar
faculty.summary: Studies brain imaging techniques such as magnetoencephalography and electroencephalography to understand disorders like autism spectrum disorder and schizophrenia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑成像技术如脑磁图和脑电图，以理解自闭症谱系障碍和精神分裂症等疾病。

faculty.name: Amelia J. Eisch
faculty.summary: Studies how molecular and cellular changes in the hippocampus affect learning, memory, anxiety, and stress response, using genetic, molecular, and behavioral approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究海马区的分子和细胞变化如何影响学习、记忆、焦虑和应激反应，采用遗传学、分子生物学和行为学方法。

faculty.name: M.D. Sheila Shanmugan
faculty.summary: Studies the development of brain networks and their relation to psychopathology in youth using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年脑网络的发展及其与精神病理学的关系，使用神经影像学技术。

faculty.name: Russell A Epstein
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of spatial representation in humans, focusing on the parahippocampal place area (PPA) and its role in scene and place recognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类空间表征的神经机制，重点关注帕拉海马体地点区（PPA）及其在场景和地点识别中的作用。

faculty.name: Christopher M. Fang-Yen
faculty.summary: Studies aging and behavior in C. elegans using optogenetics and imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用光遗传学和成像技术研究衰老和行为的秀丽隐杆线虫。

faculty.name: Li Shen
faculty.summary: Develops and applies advanced AI/ML methods to analyze large-scale biobank and health datasets to improve understanding and treatment of complex disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和应用先进的AI/ML方法分析大规模生物银行和健康数据集，以提高对复杂疾病的理解与治疗。

faculty.name: Martha J. Farah
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience, focusing on brain systems for behavior and their development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知神经科学，关注行为的脑系统及其发展。

faculty.name: Loretta M. Flanagan-Cato
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and molecular effects of steroids on brain circuits controlling reproductive and ingestive behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究类固醇对控制生殖和摄食行为的大脑回路的细胞和分子效应。

faculty.name: Brett L. Foster
faculty.summary: Studies human brain networks supporting memory and perception using neurosurgical recordings, neuroimaging, and neuromodulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用神经外科记录、神经成像和神经调节研究支持记忆和知觉的人类脑网络。

faculty.name: Maria Neimark Geffen
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain encodes auditory information and how emotional state affects perception, using computational and biological approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码听觉信息以及情绪状态如何影响知觉，采用计算和生物学方法。

faculty.name: Christoph A. Thaiss
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Sharon L Thompson-Schill
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of semantic memory using fMRI and neuropsychology, focusing on the role of frontal lobes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语义记忆的神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和神经心理学，重点关注前额叶的作用。

faculty.name: Marco Tizzano
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经影像学技术。

faculty.name: Jena Shaw Tronieri
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Harvey J Grill
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits and transmitter systems in the caudal brainstem that control meal size and food intake.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究控制餐食大小和食物摄入的尾脑干神经回路和递质系统。

faculty.name: M.D. Murray Grossman
faculty.summary: Studies biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases, focusing on frontotemporal degeneration, neurolinguistics, and executive functioning using behavioral, imaging, and biofluid measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病中的生物标志物，重点关注前颞叶退化、神经语言学和执行功能，使用行为、成像和生物体液测量方法。

faculty.name: Flavia Vitale
faculty.summary: Develops bioelectronic interfaces and nanomaterials for neurorehabilitation and neuromuscular diagnostics.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发生物电子接口和纳米材料，用于神经康复和神经肌肉诊断。

faculty.name: Ruben C. Gur
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neuroimaging aspects of schizophrenia, focusing on neurodevelopment and social cognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症的认知和神经成像方面，重点关注神经发育和社会认知。

faculty.name: Rebecca E Waller
faculty.summary: Studies the developmental origins of violence, aggression, and psychopathy, focusing on genetic, neural, and environmental risk factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究暴力、攻击性和反社会行为的发展起源，重点关注遗传、神经和环境风险因素。

faculty.name: Franz Weber
faculty.summary: Studies the neural and homeostatic mechanisms controlling REM sleep and its functional roles in emotional behaviors using optogenetics and in vivo electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究REM睡眠的神经和稳态机制及其在情绪行为中的功能作用，使用光遗传学和体内电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Michael P Hart
faculty.summary: Studies how genes regulate behaviors by defining cellular and molecular mechanisms, using C. elegans to test and compare gene impacts on neurons, synapses, circuits, and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因如何调节行为，通过定义细胞和分子机制，在秀丽隐杆线虫中测试和比较基因对神经元、突触、回路和行为的影响。

faculty.name: Corinde E. Wiers
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of metabolic ketosis on brain energetics and alcohol consumption in substance use disorder using PET and MRI neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究代谢酮症对酒精成瘾患者大脑能量代谢和酒精摄入的影响，使用正电子发射断层扫描和磁共振成像神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: Emily Hartwell
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and pharmacological factors influencing alcohol use disorder and substance use disorders, using genetic, neuroimaging, and clinical data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究酒精使用障碍和物质使用障碍的遗传和药理因素，使用遗传学、神经影像学和临床数据。

faculty.name: Beth A Winkelstein
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用行为和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Hao Huang
faculty.summary: Studies brain development and neuropsychiatric disorders using advanced neuroimaging techniques and big-data analytics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和神经精神障碍，使用先进的神经影像技术和大数据分析。

faculty.name: Yeong Shin Yim
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of inflammation on social behavior in mice, using behavioral tests and genetic models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究炎症对小鼠社会行为的影响，使用行为测试和遗传模型。

faculty.name: Li-Feng Jiang-Xie
faculty.summary: Studies the function and origin of sleep using electrophysiology, two-photon imaging, and computational tools to develop a theory of self-cleansing brain during sleep.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠的功能和起源，使用电生理学、双光子成像和计算工具来发展大脑自我清洁的理论。

faculty.name: Michelle Jillian Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of robot-assisted interventions on brain plasticity and motor control in aging, neural disease, and injury.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究机器人辅助干预对衰老、神经疾病和损伤引起的脑可塑性和运动控制的影响。
